		war = yes
		NOT = {
			owns = 1782
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = {
				has_country_modifier = wants_province_1782_back
			}
			NOT = {
				has_country_modifier = wants_province_1782
			}
		}
		1782 = {
			total_pops = 400000
			NOT = {
				total_pops = 800000
			}
			owner = {
				war_with = THIS
			}
		}
		OR = {
			1782 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				1782 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	allow = {
		1782 = {
			controller = {
				tag = THIS
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		badboy = 8
		add_country_modifier = {
			name = wants_province_1782
			duration = -1
		}
		1782 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		factor = 1
		modifier = {
			factor = 0
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					NOT = {
						badboy = 0.48
					}
					1782 = {
						state_scope = {
							OR = {
								AND = {
									is_colonial = yes
									total_pops = 2000000
								}
								AND = {
									is_colonial = no
									total_pops = 2200000
								}
							}
							NOT = {
								any_owned_province = {
									is_core = THIS
								}

						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

		war = yes
		NOT = {
			owns = 1905
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = {
				has_country_modifier = wants_province_1905_back
			}
			NOT = {
				has_country_modifier = wants_province_1905
			}
		}
		1905 = {
			total_pops = 400000
			NOT = {
				total_pops = 800000
			}
			owner = {
				war_with = THIS
			}
		}
		OR = {
			1905 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				1905 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	allow = {
		1905 = {
			controller = {
				tag = THIS
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		badboy = 8
		add_country_modifier = {
			name = wants_province_1905
			duration = -1
		}
		1905 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		factor = 1
		modifier = {
			factor = 0
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					NOT = {
						badboy = 0.48
					}
					1905 = {
						state_scope = {
							OR = {
								AND = {
									is_colonial = yes
									total_pops = 2000000
								}
								AND = {
									is_colonial = no
									total_pops = 2200000
								}
							}
							NOT = {
								any_owned_province = {
									is_core = THIS
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

				}

		war = yes
		NOT = {
			owns = 590
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = {
				has_country_modifier = wants_province_590_back
			}
			NOT = {
				has_country_modifier = wants_province_590
			}
		}
		590 = {
			total_pops = 400000
			NOT = {
				total_pops = 800000
			}
			owner = {
				war_with = THIS
			}
		}
		OR = {
			590 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				590 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	allow = {
		590 = {
			controller = {
				tag = THIS
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		badboy = 8
		add_country_modifier = {
			name = wants_province_590
			duration = -1
		}
		590 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		factor = 1
		modifier = {
			factor = 0
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					NOT = {
						badboy = 0.48
					}
					590 = {
						state_scope = {
							OR = {
								AND = {
									is_colonial = yes
									total_pops = 2000000
								}
								AND = {
									is_colonial = no
									total_pops = 2200000
								}
							}
							NOT = {
								any_owned_province = {
									is_core = THIS
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

		war = yes
		NOT = {
			owns = 1675
		}
		AND = {
			NOT = {
				has_country_modifier = wants_province_1675_back
			}
			NOT = {
				has_country_modifier = wants_province_1675
			}
		}
		1675 = {
			total_pops = 400000
			NOT = {
				total_pops = 800000
			}
			owner = {
				war_with = THIS
			}
		}
		OR = {
			1675 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				1675 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	allow = {
		1675 = {
			controller = {
				tag = THIS
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		badboy = 8
		add_country_modifier = {
			name = wants_province_1675
			duration = -1
		}
		1675 = {
			add_province_modifier = {
				name = wanted_by_someone
				duration = -1
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		factor = 1
		modifier = {
			factor = 0
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					NOT = {
						badboy = 0.48
					}
					1675 = {
						state_scope = {
							OR = {
								AND = {
									is_colonial = yes
									total_pops = 2000000
								}
								AND = {
									is_colonial = no
									total_pops = 2200000
								}
							}
							NOT = {
								any_owned_province = {
									is_core = THIS
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

		}

			}
			NOT = {
				has_country_modifier = wants_province_2439
			}
		}
		2439 = {
			total_pops = 400000
			NOT = {
				total_pops = 800000
			}
			owner = {
				war_with = THIS
			}
		}
		OR = {
			2439 = {
				any_neighbor_province = {
					owned_by = THIS
				}
			}
			AND = {
				num_of_ports = 1
				2439 = {
					port = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	allow = {

			controller = {

			}
		}

			duration = -1
		}
		2439 = {

			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = {

					NOT = {
						badboy = 0.48
					}

								AND = {
									is_colonial = yes
